title: Identifying Cyclic Linear Structural Equations from Baseline Covariance and Sparse Intervention Means
banked_reason: D0.5 delivered incremental below field floor; paper_score_ceiling 6.2 < 7.4; not salvageable within scope.
gap_reasons: They do not cover sparse probe menus that leave extension equations unrecovered, degenerate core strata, or other sparse feedback topologies.
The claimed reproducible generator is specified and given a bit bound, but no implementation, independently checkable output, or k=2–8 validation is delivered.
D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.2 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved a two-branch structural-pair and effect certificate from baseline covariance and sparse clamp means for a regular parallel-return model. The mathematical and decision reviews passed, but the independent novelty review placed the delivered result below the field floor because it excludes unrecovered extension rows, degenerate strata, and broader feedback topologies; the specified certificate generator also lacks executable validation. A field-tier re-raise would need a new kernel for those omitted cases, not merely more examples of the present theorem.
tldr: For a known loopless support, a baseline covariance, and one nonzero-dose population mean response at each selected target, the regular parallel-return linear SEM with centered finite-variance disturbances and positive diagonal exogenous covariance has a complete structural-pair moment fibre of size at most two. Probe means recover targeted equations and variances; one quadratic and a unique extension lift enumerate branches stable on the declared menu, and a polynomial-bit certificate returns the exact equilibrium-effect set for rational input. Higher-order exogenous dependence is allowed. In the centered jointly Gaussian restriction the same moments determine complete baseline and labelled clamp laws.
gap: The same-input/output task is known loopless permitted support plus a baseline covariance and retained complete labelled hard-probe laws in, and every support-contained strictly stable structural branch and all target-effect values out. IIC gives generic seeded coefficient status; general algebraic SEM equations, Gröbner examples, and acyclic generic-query solvers give fibres or generic degrees without this family-specific intervention and stability certificate. The joint pointwise guarantee remains an inferred, targeted gap.
fill: Establish the root/lift bijection and normalized clamp recovery; prove the corrected cubic Schur endpoint rule; classify probe separation and query equality; deliver an exact fraction-free certificate generator and polynomial rational-input bit bound for the explicitly listed stability menu.
